alex_cheng: Heads-up — we had a P99 latency plateau during the 11:02 scale event. Traffic spiked ~3x, autoscaler started nodes but tails stayed high (~450-600ms). Runtime logs show kernel-selection churn + long KV cache priming on new pods. digging into logs now and posting traces.
infra-bot: [alert] model-serving-pool-3 P99=542ms, nodes_added=5, warm_pool_used=1, warm_pool_alloc_failures=2
jess_m: I saw kernel score oscillation in the debug stream earlier. kernel selector was flipping between fused_attention_v1 and gemm_v2 every few seconds which causes repeated JIT-like prep work. that plus KV prefetch not finishing explains extra ~200-300ms.
tomo_n: quick paste from runtime log around 11:05:
```
2026-11-12T11:05:03Z kernel_select: fused_attention_v1 score=0.47 -> gemm_v2 score=0.52
2026-11-12T11:05:04Z kernel_prepare: compile_start pid=42
2026-11-12T11:05:04Z kvcache: prefetch start keys=1200 target=1024
2026-11-12T11:05:04Z gpu: util=98% memcpy=high pci_bandwidth=0.8GB/s
2026-11-12T11:05:05Z kernel_select: gemm_v2 -> fused_attention_v1 (fallback) \n```
This looks like noisy-neighbor GPU saturation — high memcpy and util while kernel selection keeps toggling due to score jitter.
bench-bot: quick perf snapshot (canary vs affected)
- baseline (10:30): p50=18ms p95=72ms p99=120ms tps=650
- during spike (11:02): p50=22ms p95=130ms p99=542ms tps=610
flamegraph: https://internal/fg/1957772222 (profiling: high memcpy stalls on memcpy_async)
sylvia_r: found a config mismatch that caused warm-pool not to be used for 2 of the new nodes — warm pool label on the pool is `pool=fast-gpu` but the scale-up request annotated `pool=fast`. autoscaler fell back to cold provisioning for those, which explains the extended KV priming.
```
ScalePolicy:
  min_replicas: 10
  warm_pool_min: 2
  pool_label: pool=fast-gpu
Request (11:01): pool=fast
```
alex_cheng: Proposed short-term mitigations:
- pin kernel selection to `gemm_v2` for the affected model on canary (will avoid JIT churn)
- increase warm_pool_min from 2 -> 6 for the high-traffic zone and fix pool label mismatch
- extend autoscaler cooldown to 45s to avoid repeated churn
- add a KV prefetch healthcheck to consider a node "ready-for-serving" only after prefetch finishes
jess_m: I'll run the kernel pin canary (gemm_v2) and flip the warm pool label fix. will monitor for 15m then roll.
tomo_n: also raising a follow-up item: selector score smoothing — add hysteresis (0.1) and a minimum hold window (5s) to stop oscillation.
infra-bot: canary rolled out to 5 pods at 11:12 — P99 dropped to 130ms within 90s, warm pool re-alloc fixed at 11:14, monitoring continues :thumbsup:
alex_cheng: great, creating postmortem/next-steps doc and assigning the selector-smoothing ticket to @tomo_n. thanks everyone for quick triage.
